title: AttentionDecisionV2
description: I-010B AttentionDecisionV2@8 — the closed host-facing decision union. @8 (#94 step 6; Zoe, 2026-10-06) adds the optional answer calls_for_participant, asked only when the request lists unattended_event_ids: which of those messages still calls for the participant, asked of it or of the room and not yet answered; it must name one of the request's unattended messages (runtime-adapter-only cross-check), and step 1 never suppresses a judgment that names one. @7 (#94 step 6) adds the policy-defer override cause outcome-turn: on a request whose occasion is outcome, a SUPPRESS or ACK judgment widens to DEFER, because the participant reports what its approved action did, and only such a request may use it (runtime-adapter-only cross-check). @6 (#94 step 5) adds two step-2 answers that the participant's memory builds threads from: asks, whether the judged message asks someone in the room for something, and responds_to, which earlier supplied message it answers or responds to, the participant's own included. @5 (Zoe, 2026-10-05, #94 step 4) grounds every status-ok judgment in the model's typed answers (answers): step 1 asks whether the judged message is conversation, step 2 asks who it is addressed to, whether and by which message it was answered, whether its author is mid-thought, whether the participant has something to add, and which kinds of response could fit. answers replaces the V1-era legacy_verdict_confidences vector, which is no longer allowed. @4 let the reading of the room (attention_advice) accompany every status-ok judgment and bounded it to at most 4 items of at most 400 characters each. @3 added first-class ACK classifier and effective dispositions, ACK->ACK and conservative ACK->DEFER transitions, capability-defer routing, and an ACK-only audit binding the exact reaction, trusted policy provenance, and authenticated permission revision. Bypass and error carry no answers or reading because no model judgment exists for them.

confidence.$comment: Finite [0,1]. The contradictory-bounds not-clause rejects NaN, which vacuously satisfies every numeric comparison keyword; strict JSON cannot carry non-finite literals, but sentinel-decoded corpus instances can.

attentionAdvice.$comment: One item of the classifier's reading of the room: a short description of what is happening or of a kind of response that could fit, grounded in named evidence events. A recommendation, never a system instruction.

evidence_event_ids.$comment: Every citation must reference an event ID supplied in the request; that cross-document rule is runtime-adapter-only (FR-012/FR-013).

routingAudit.$comment: The closed FR-005 routing audit with its per-combination rules: a margin counts as applied exactly on valve margin-defer — the effective margin is then required and is forbidden on every other valve, override cause must be margin, and the margin status must be active (a retired margin cannot apply); the trusted margin source may appear only on that margin-applied decision (optional there); valves none and classifier-defer pair with override cause none; valve policy-defer pairs with override cause suppression-disabled, recoverability-unproven, ack-disabled, or (@7) outcome-turn.

effective_margin.$comment: Finite [0, 1] (@2 amendment A2, c834e8c 'a transition margin, when active, is a finite number within [0,1]'; the accepted @1 shape wrongly used exclusiveMinimum, excluding the exact boundary the retained inclusive <= comparison relies on). The contradictory-bounds not-clause rejects NaN exactly as $defs/confidence does.

reasons.$comment: A required sibling ok-branch audit field — never a member of the routing-audit object — retained as audit material that never enters the participant turn.

answers.$comment: The model's typed answers behind the judgment (@5; asks and responds_to since @6). Yes/no questions are the probability of yes; choices give a probability for every option (normalized to sum to 1 by the core); answered_by, when present, names the supplied message that answered or handled the judged message, and responds_to the earlier supplied message the judged message answers or responds to (those cross-document rules are runtime-adapter-only).

attention_advice.$comment: The classifier's reading of the room; optional on every status-ok pair (@4).

oneOf.$comment: WAKE->WAKE: valve none (no widening valve applied).
ACK->ACK: one core-selected lightweight reaction with current authenticated native capability.
ACK->DEFER: disabled ACK policy conservatively wakes the participant path; since @7 an outcome turn also widens (outcome-turn).
ACK->DEFER: unavailable authenticated reaction capability conservatively wakes the participant path.
DEFER->DEFER: the classifier-defer valve, distinct from margin-defer (S08).
SUPPRESS->DEFER: widened by the uncertainty margin with its exact audit.
SUPPRESS->DEFER: widened by disabled suppression, unproven recovery, or (@7) an outcome turn, never by ACK policy.
SUPPRESS->SUPPRESS: governed suppression with no widening valve applied (S05).

allOf.$comment: The exact reaction and authority revision accompany ACK and no other classifier selection.

bypass.$comment: A non-social no-classifier outcome excluding the full FR-005 set: no classifier/effective disposition, classifier audit, reasons, evidence, typed answers, legacy confidence vector, routing audit, or advice. Not a successful disposition pairing; it must not fabricate a model judgment.

error.$comment: The tagged operational branch: malformed output, illegal pairings, and malformed typed answers land here and cannot fabricate a social suppression. request_id is optional on both the pre-validation and post-validation branches (a pre-validation error may occur before a request ID is assignable); classifier is optional and present only when the error occurred after classifier invocation. code is the authority's open string (FR-014, rejection R7) — not a locally narrowed enum; detail is required (the authority's complete error object is {code, detail}, both required).
